text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, Summer camp starts 
today! ...That said, something really does 
seem off with City-san."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"City-san is strong, cool, and a perfect 
Umamusume. There's nothing I could ever 
do... or so I thought, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"When Trainer asked me, 'Does anyone who 
is completely perfect really exist?'... it 
reminded me of how that girl looked during 
the Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"It might be presumptuous of me, but... If 
I get the chance, I'm thinking of trying 
to talk to City-san."
